nodes.title:
Plivo for India outbound voice (docs read 2026-10-23; research/2026-10-23/plivo-kyc/api-notes.md).
- Who can rent: only an India-registered business on an India data-region org (INR only, Indian cards only, India-only calling, no SMS).
- KYC: every number needs an accepted Compliance API application before rent or calls. A Requirements endpoint gives the document types and fields; one multipart POST auto-submits; status comes by signed webhook; the buy call takes compliance_application_id.
- Number series: landlines carry service and transactional calls only; 140 is for promotional calls; 160 is for banks and financial firms only.
- 140/160 registration: no API. Tata DLT registration plus a declaration to Plivo, about 5-14 business days.
- Rules: cold calling is prohibited; repeated UCC complaints can blacklist a business for a year.
- Bring-your-own: no BYO Indian caller ID and no India porting. A SIP trunk works only if SIP and media terminate in India (otherwise hangup 4590).
- Open: the docs contradict each other on how many documents are required (21 UNVERIFIED items in the notes).
nodes.method: Main loop subagent read Plivo's public docs (plivo.com/docs .md pages and llms-full.txt). No logins and no API calls. Each claim cites a source URL with its read date.

nodes.title:
India number tools, from Plivo's real surface.
- number.kyc.submit: built on the Compliance API, with the form generated from the live Requirements endpoint (never hard-coded documents).
- a2p.declare: a guided manual flow (DLT checklist, declaration, status kept by Vyakti support), not an API call.
- byo.connect: refuses for India with the reason (no Indian BYO caller ID or porting). A SIP trunk is considered only if the voice runtime terminates SIP in India.
- Campaign categories map to series: service and transactional calls on landlines; promotional calls only on a 140 number.
nodes.rationale: Plivo's docs: KYC has an API; 140/160 registration and BYO do not exist as APIs for India. Building against imagined endpoints would fail at the first real rental.
nodes.reverse_if: Plivo publishes an A2P/DLT API for India, enables Indian BYO, or we move to a carrier that offers these.
